description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Jungle Basin.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Jungle Basin.
Repeat.

uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Locus of Enlightenment
